Ashok Singh .... Petitioner

 -versus-
 State of Odisha & .... Opposite Parties
 another
 Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
08.10.2024 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Special G.R. Case No.118 of 2024, pending on the file of learned A.D.J.-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack, arising out of Maniabandha P.S.
Case No. 56 of 2024 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 363/376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned A.D.J.-cum- Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack by order dated 23.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 16.07.2024 and as charge sheet has been filed on 03.09.2024 under Sections 363/376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act, the Petitioner may be released on bail.
6. The copy of the final form submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner is taken on record.
7. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: 8. This Court perused the 164 Cr.P.C. Statement of the victim.
9. Considering the same, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

10. Additionally, it is directed that Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
11. It is directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the victim and her family.
12. It shall be open to the victim/Prosecution to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat perception.
13. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
14. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
